subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should WebChat provider-backed voice be split into Gateway TTS Read aloud plus editable batch dictation through `tools.media.audio`, or should maintainers treat realtime Talk as the supported voice path and close or narrow the remaining request?
rationale: Current code has multiple overlapping voice paths, and the choice affects user UX, provider routing, credentials, microphone-audio privacy, and whether a new Gateway audio RPC is acceptable.

options.title: Split TTS and batch dictation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, repair or replace PR #76027 for Read aloud, and route editable mic capture through the narrower #98026/#98027 style `tools.media.audio` path.

options.title: Narrow to TTS only
options.body: Retitle or scope this issue to Gateway-backed Read aloud and make editable dictation the canonical STT tracker elsewhere.

options.title: Use Talk as the voice answer
options.body: Treat realtime or transcription Talk as the supported WebChat voice product direction and close or supersede the batch dictation part after documenting that decision.

recommendation.title: Split TTS and batch dictation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, repair or replace PR #76027 for Read aloud, and route editable mic capture through the narrower #98026/#98027 style `tools.media.audio` path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the open Read aloud candidate and has the strongest linked history on the relevant WebChat voice boundary.
